coverage_explanation: Tests released-button startup, two independent presses, completion after button release, yellow and red phase durations with boundary samples, return to green, idle stability, and required pin modes. Held-button retrigger policy is unspecified and is not constrained.
assumptions: Explicit circuit wiring overrides bench defaults: LEDs on pins 8, 9, and 10 are active HIGH; button pin 2 is externally pulled LOW and pressed HIGH.
Traffic-light phases are interpreted as mutually exclusive: yellow switches off when red starts, and red switches off when green returns.
Allow approximately 200ms response and phase-boundary margin; no particular debounce algorithm is required.
Button presses last 500ms and are released before the sequence ends; behavior for a button held across completion is unspecified.
